notes.title: Hangry Early Access Release Sept 27th
notes.notes: [p]Time to book your table reservations. We are excited to announce that Hangry will be released on Early Access Saturday September 27th, 2025! It will release with a promo sale that will last for the duration of Steam's Autumn sale.[/p][p][/p][p]Plus with your main course, you get Hangry's first comic book "First Course" for FREE![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44859093/f85ecc9eb4a65ced4446f6e5c9edbfca87393261.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Learn about the origins of Hangry and how he joined Chef Goutra and got himself involved in the shady and delicious world the food underground.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44859093/56dd71d3fbea3e892ccff1a4aee9e7a21683b316.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Try out the DEMO which is available right now. You get access to the game's tutorial and first mission! You can continue your demo save file on the full game.[/p][p][/p][p]Add to your Wishlist today![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2601510/HANGRY/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Get the Hangry Comic Book "First Course" on Release!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44859093/f85ecc9eb4a65ced4446f6e5c9edbfca87393261.png[/img]

Available when the game releases, comes Hangry's first comic, "First Course"! Experience a moment in the blue hunter's history and how the ferocious creature met the up and coming chef, Goutra. Will be available as DLC.
